text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove keeps nodding off during training today…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: My apologies. Could you repeat that explanation once more?
choice_data_list: Are you okay? You seem a bit… off.
Are you okay? You seem a bit… off.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I haven't been getting much sleep lately. The student council work keeps piling up.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I decided to do a little before bed, but before I realized it, the sun was up.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: All the same, the work needs to be done. Don't worry—none of this should be of your concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove casually brushes it off, but she's clearly exhausted. I should keep this in mind.
